uncited: **Position & Normal Computation:** Compute the final vertex position and world-space coordinates.
**Texture Sampling & Color Blending:** Scale the world position for texture sampling.
- **Degenerate Input:** If the normal is zero or undefined, the topness and blending factors may be incorrect.
This method is part of the Zylann's VoxelGame project, an open-source voxel engine for Godot.
It extends the Transvoxel algorithm to provide high-quality terrain texturing.
